narration: Here lies bower/bower, a repository that once breathed with the bustle of a town square. It was born into the world, gathered a crowd of hands, and sent out a long procession of releases. Its cadence slowed, then decayed; momentum thinned to nothing. The last breath came not in a crash but in a hush—a long idle silence after the final sign of life. The verdict is abandonment, though the door was never sealed with an archive. A fragile thread of stewardship held the project at the end, while open questions lingered unanswered. We do not mock the keeper; we keep vigil. In the Dia de los Muertos spirit, we set out marigolds for the code that still waits in the dark, not dead enough to be buried, not living enough to answer. May the repository rest in the amber light of memory, and may its unresolved issues be remembered as small candles, not accusations. The town is quiet now.
